abstract: BACKGROUND: Anti-NMDA-R receptor encephalitis occurs predominantly in younger women and is often comorbid with ovarian teratoma, a feature that is often absent in children. Here, we report our experience with two pediatric patients, in whom no tumors were present during treatment for encephalitis, but in whom ovarian teratomas developed without encephalitis relapse after treatment was completed. CASES: Patient 1 was a 14-year-old girl who was diagnosed due to characteristic symptoms and anti-NMDA-R antibody. MRI scanning during treatment revealed no ovarian tumors, but a tumor developed in the right ovary 10months after onset. Another tumor developed in the left ovary 3years after onset, and a mature ovarian teratoma was confirmed after bilateral partial ovariectomy. Patient 2 was an 11-year old girl who was also diagnosed due to characteristic symptoms and anti-NMDA-R antibody. Imaging during treatment revealed no ovarian tumors, but a 2.5-cm tumor mass was found in the left ovary 10months after onset, and a mature ovarian teratoma was confirmed after partial ovariectomy. DISCUSSION: This case report suggests the need for regular tumor screening after treatment for anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis because of potential subsequent tumor development, even in pediatric patients who initially present with no comorbid tumors. No analysis of relapse risk has yet been reported in cases of tumor development after treatment, and at this point, whether or not resection is needed to prevent relapse remains unclear. However, because teratomas usually grow, have an associated risk of torsion, and can be malignant, tumor removal should be considered.
abstract_ja:
背景：抗NMDA受容体脳炎は主に若年女性に発症し、卵巣奇形腫を合併することが多いが、小児ではこの特徴は通常認められない。本稿では、脳炎の治療中には腫瘍が認められなかったが、治療終了後に脳炎の再発を伴わず卵巣奇形腫が発生した小児患者2例の経験を報告する。
症例：患者1は14歳の女児で、特徴的な症状と抗NMDA-R抗体により診断された。治療中のMRI検査では卵巣腫瘍は認められなかったが、発症10か月後に右卵巣に腫瘍が発生した。発症3年後には左卵巣にも別の腫瘍が発生し、両側卵巣部分切除術後に成熟卵巣奇形腫と確定診断された。患者2は11歳の女児で、同じく特徴的な症状と抗NMDA-R抗体により診断された。治療中の画像検査では卵巣腫瘍は認められなかったが、発症10か月後に左卵巣に2.5cmの腫瘤が認められ、卵巣部分切除術後に成熟卵巣奇形腫と確定診断された。
考察：本症例報告は、抗NMDA受容体脳炎の治療後には、当初は合併腫瘍を有さなかった小児患者であっても、その後に腫瘍が発生する可能性があるため、定期的な腫瘍スクリーニングの必要性を示唆する。腫瘍発生後の再発リスクに関する解析はこれまで報告されておらず、再発を防ぐために切除が必要かどうかは現時点では不明である。しかし、奇形腫は通常増大し、捻転のリスクを伴い、悪性化しうるため、腫瘍の摘出を検討すべきである。
